name: hcportal_addSong
description: Creates a new song record in HC.Song and immediately links it to the requesting kennel via HC.KennelSongMap. Both inserts are wrapped in a single transaction. The authenticated hasher is recorded as AddedBy_UserId; the resolved internal kennelId as AddedBy_KennelId. ImageUrl, AudioUrl, AutoAddToKennel, and Rank are not set at creation time (ImageUrl/AudioUrl = NULL, AutoAddToKennel = 0, Rank = 0). Caller must hold authIsSuperAdmin (0x40000000) or authCanManageSongs (0x00000040) for the requesting kennel. Service accounts (callerType 1 or 2) are explicitly rejected. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as callerParamString. This is a new SP with no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Resolved to the internal Kennel.id before any writes. Validated IS NULL before auth. Also passed as the paramString to HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: songName
parameters.description: Required. Trimmed before insert. Returns error if null or blank after trim.

parameters.name: tuneOf
parameters.description: Optional. Trimmed; stored as NULL if blank.

parameters.name: lyrics
parameters.description: Optional. Trimmed; stored as '' (empty string) if null because Song.Lyrics is NOT NULL.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Optional. Trimmed; stored as NULL if blank.

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: Optional. Trimmed; stored as NULL if blank.

parameters.name: variants
parameters.description: Optional. Trimmed; stored as NULL if blank.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Optional. Trimmed; stored as NULL if blank.

parameters.name: bawdyRating
parameters.description: Required. Must be exactly 0, 1, 2, or 3. Validated before insert; returns error if null or out of range.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on any validation, auth, permission or runtime error. Short-circuits on first error. Order: publicKennelId NULL → auth → songName blank → bawdyRating range → service account (callerType != 0) → kennel not found → AppAccessFlags permission → CATCH (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: SuccessResult
rowsets.description: Returned after COMMIT when the song has been inserted and linked. Business data in rowset 0 with no Success column — callers tell the two shapes apart by column name.

columns.name: newSongId
columns.description: The id of the newly created HC.Song row

sideEffects: INSERT into HC.Song with the supplied fields; AddedBy_KennelId = resolved @kennelId, AddedBy_UserId = authenticated @hasherId, ImageUrl = NULL, AudioUrl = NULL, AutoAddToKennel = 0, Rank = 0, Removed = 0
INSERT into HC.KennelSongMap linking the new song to the requesting kennel (KennelId = resolved @kennelId, Removed = 0)
HC.Song / HC.KennelSongMap updatedAt triggers fire, so the song syncs to the kennel's phones

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 175-178 roll back and return the envelope without writing HC.ErrorLog.

Lines 109-118 test HasherKennelMap.AppAccessFlags & 0x40000040 directly instead of HC6.CheckKennelPermission, so a Mismanagement role that grants song management (the other independent grantor on HasherKennelMap) is ignored, and the gate can drift from the permission matrix.
@songName NVARCHAR(120) and @tuneOf NVARCHAR(500) (lines 7-8) silently truncate longer input; the columns are the same width, so declare NVARCHAR(MAX) and check LEN().

permissionBits.note: Check is against the kennel identified by @publicKennelId. Service accounts (callerType 1 or 2) are rejected unconditionally — they may not add songs.
